# SIZU — Social Impact Zone Uganda

> SIZU is a Ugandan platform connecting impact-driven organizations, projects, and events to drive sustainable development.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover featured impact projects and organizations.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, and the story behind SIZU.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the SIZU team.
- [Projects](/projects): Browse and search impact projects across Uganda.
- [Organizations](/organizations): Directory of registered impact organizations.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming events and the Market Place.
- [Register](/register): Create an organization account to post projects.
- [Login](/login): Sign in to manage your projects.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms and conditions of use.
